project_title: KP Insight — Cinematic 3D KP Astrology Platform
theme: Dark Deep-Space Celestial (Default) with Light Parchment Option

typography.data_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scales.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-amber-100
scales.section_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-normal text-amber-200

colors.archetype: LUXURY & PERFORMANCE PRO (Deep Celestial Obsidian + Champagne Gold + Cool Cyan)

gradients.gold_text: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-200 via-amber-400 to-yellow-100 bg-clip-text text-transparent

visual_enhancers.orbit_rings: fine 1px dashed or solid gold/cyan SVG borders representing celestial orbits
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)] for key planets and ASC node
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle starfield noise background overlay with CSS radial gradient lights

layout_and_grids.app_shell: Collapsible sidebar left nav (width 64 to 260px) + Top navigation header with status indicators & quick search + Main scrollable stage container

grid_modes.observatory_split: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 (Left 7 cols: 3D/2D Sky View & Time Panel, Right 5 cols: Chart Summary & Planet Quick Inspector)
grid_modes.chart_explorer: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 (Left 5 cols: Interactive SVG Wheel, Right 7 cols: Tabbed Planet/Cusp Tables & 4-Level Significator Matrix)
grid_modes.form_view: max-w-3xl mx-auto grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4

motion.framer_motion: Smooth entrance staggers, cinematic camera transitions, tab transitions
motion.camera_intro: Line-by-line title reveal, solar system zoom-in on launch
motion.micro_interactions: Hover glow on chart wheel cusps, planet table row focus, pulse glow on active time playback step

3d_libraries.primary: Three.js canvas with interactive 3D planetary orbits (Heliocentric & Geocentric views)
3d_libraries.fallback: Interactive SVG / Canvas astronomical sphere rendering with planet position markers, orbit rings, and node markers

component_guidelines.file_extension: Use .js or .jsx files only for React components
component_guidelines.testing_attribute: CRITICAL: Every interactive button, input, tab, select, table row, and navigational link MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or fine-cornered buttons with champagne gold or cyan borders, subtle hover glows, and crisp contrast
component_guidelines.tables: Dense, crisp data grid with sortable headers, search filter, copy button, and row highlight sync with chart wheel
component_guidelines.chart_wheel: Custom SVG wheel rendering 12 Placidus cusps, 12 Zodiac signs, 27 Nakshatras, and planet icons with hover tooltips for Star-Lord, Sub-Lord, and Sub-Sub-Lord
component_guidelines.significator_matrix: Interactive 4-level significator grid with Cusp-based vs Whole-sign toggle
component_guidelines.language_toggle: English / Telugu (EN / TE) toggle button in top bar
component_guidelines.calculation_badge: Status indicator with states: Ephemeris (built-in), Demo fixture, Pending module

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, cinematic, fully functional Milestone 1 web application for KP Insight.
Implement the live 3D / 2D Planetary Observatory with interactive orbit controls, play/pause, step hour/day/month, and view toggle (Heliocentric vs Geocentric KP Sky Zodiac Ring).
Build the KP Chart Explorer with custom interactive SVG chart wheel (12 cusps, signs, 27 nakshatras, planet markers, hover tooltips with Star-Lord and Sub-Lord details).
Include full Planetary Table & Cusp Table with search, sorting, copy to clipboard, and detail side panel.
Include 4-level Significator View with Cusp-based vs Whole-sign toggle.
Provide Birth Chart Form with city search, date/time pickers, and pre-filled sample profiles (e.g. Krishnamurti Natal Chart, Famous Persona, Custom).

Implement the App Shell with collapsible left sidebar for all planned modules (Dasha, Sade Sati, Horary, Career, Marriage, Finance, Gemstones, Rudraksha, Remedies, Wellbeing, Knowledge Library, Reports).
Module pages under development must show beautiful 'In Development' interactive preview screens with roadmap timelines and feature highlights.
Ensure global chart selector, quick search dialog, English/Telugu language switcher, and calculation status indicator are functional in top bar.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
